about: Standard deck selection. candidate = index into deck-src/candidates/candidates.json; box (optional) overrides the crop in working-copy page pixels; title (optional) overrides the catalogue title — bracketed titles are cataloguer-supplied descriptions for untitled vignettes.

cards.caption: A chameleon-headed man in a tailcoat dropping a paper into a ballot box.
A magpie lady in an enormous crinoline writing with a quill.
A spaniel in a frock coat holding a hunting horn behind his back.
A rabbit gentleman in a jacket next to a table with a top hat and books.
A hare in a jacket and trousers holding a top hat upside down.
A portly vulture landlord in a top hat and greatcoat leaning on a cane.
A rooster dandy in a tailcoat posing with a riding crop.
A crocodile in a top hat dabbing its eyes at a shop counter, a body at its feet.
An insect gentleman in a tailcoat admiring a portrait on the wall.
An old butterfly dandy sniffing a vase of flowers, hat in hand.
A crow in a tailcoat hurrying down a city street.
An old animal veteran in a bicorne hat leaning on a sword.
A stork in a judge’s black robe and white wig.
A wolf chained in a prison cell, reading a book.
A little animal housemaid in a bonnet and apron.
An old mouse seamstress in a long dress sitting in a wooden armchair.
A cat peering at mice trapped inside a cage.
A long-beaked bird traveller with a backpack and walking stick.
A bird officer in a cocked hat, plaid cape and riding boots.
A wolf standing guard in a cape, holding a rifle over his shoulder.
A creature in a straw hat chasing butterflies with a net.
A she-wolf lady in a grand ball gown.
A fox in an overcoat holding his top hat.
A swaggering musketeer in a plumed hat and cape.
A heron lady in a full dress carrying a handbag.
A stork standing over a gathering of black birds by a stone column.
A shrew in shirtsleeves drilling into the ground with a hand auger, a pickaxe at its feet.
An old falcon gentleman in a long coat and spotted waistcoat.
A dog hunter with a rifle leaning on a fence.
A turkey banker in a suit fanning his huge tail.
An owl lady in a frilly ball gown.
An old bird servant in a coat, hands clasped behind its back.

cards.title: [The pocket knife]
cards.caption: An open pocket knife standing upright like a person, casting a long shadow.

cards.title: [Duel of the quill pens]
cards.caption: Two quill pens with faces fighting a sword duel.

cards.title: [A pen nib on the march]
cards.caption: A walking pen nib carrying a bundle and a pennant toward the rising sun.

cards.title: [The grinning gentleman]
cards.caption: A grinning one-eyed gentleman with an eye patch and crossed legs, holding his hat.

cards.title: [Steam-powered musicians]
cards.caption: Steam engines making music: one blows a trumpet, another reads a score.

cards.title: [The harp machine]
cards.caption: A steam machine playing the harp beside a baby’s cradle.

cards.title: [The column and the crowd]
cards.caption: A tall monument column surrounded by a swirl of tiny people, coaches and objects.

cards.title: [Dance of the rabbits]
cards.caption: Rabbits and a fox dancing wildly while a bird in a cloak watches.

cards.title: [The winged dancer]
cards.caption: A ballerina with dragonfly wings dancing on tiptoe.

cards.title: [Ballet of legs]
cards.caption: Leaping ballerinas in front of a row of disembodied dancing legs.

cards.title: Le Royaume des marionnettes
cards.caption: A jointed wooden marionette dancer with too many arms and legs.

cards.title: Combat de deux raffinés
cards.caption: Two vegetable gentlemen with leafy heads fighting a duel with long spears.

cards.title: [Taken for a walk]
cards.caption: A huge dog walking a tiny man in a top hat on a leash.

cards.title: [The monkey painter]
cards.caption: A monkey painter at an easel while another monkey watches.

cards.title: [Studio of the apes]
cards.caption: Monkeys in a painting studio, one working on a huge canvas while others copy him.

cards.title: [The giant thumb]
cards.caption: A gigantic thumb and fist carved as statues, with a tiny sculptor at work.

cards.title: [The black sun]
cards.caption: A black sun with long rays rising over the mountains.

cards.title: [The flying frog]
cards.caption: A frog flying on enormous eagle wings.

cards.title: La Poursuite
cards.caption: A toucan ridden by a goblin chasing a bear and a tortoise while strange birds fly overhead.

cards.title: [The menagerie]
cards.caption: A zoo enclosure with a giraffe, a stork, an owl, a tortoise and odd creatures.

cards.title: [Garden of crystals]
cards.caption: A landscape of crystals, pyramids, towers and dice.

cards.title: [Garden of strange plants]
cards.caption: A clifftop garden of plants shaped like feathers, combs, shells and brushes.

cards.title: [Tightrope over the flowers]
cards.caption: A spidery acrobat walking a tightrope above a field of flowers.

cards.title: [Flowers at the gate]
cards.caption: Flowers with faces walking out through an arched doorway.

cards.title: [The vegetable assembly]
cards.caption: Vegetables and flowers with faces holding a meeting.

cards.title: [Flying with kites]
cards.caption: A man floating above the clouds held up by kites.

cards.title: [The flying man]
cards.caption: A man flying with giant feather wings strapped to his body.

cards.title: [The very tall man]
cards.caption: An impossibly tall, thin man looming over a seated woman.

cards.title: [The smiling lyre]
cards.caption: A lyre with a smiling face, framed by laurel branches and rays of light.

cards.title: [Cupid with a cane]
cards.caption: A cupid leaning on a walking stick beside a butterfly.

cards.title: [The cow idol]
cards.caption: A cow-headed idol seated on a pedestal in clouds of smoke.

cards.title: [The political clockwork]
cards.caption: A giant clock machine above a grumpy giant, with tiny men riding seesaws.

cards.title: [Dancer between the fans]
cards.caption: A tiny dancer suspended between two enormous fan-like leaves.

cards.title: [The ladder of ambition]
cards.caption: Officers in plumed hats scrambling over each other up a ladder, waving papers.

cards.title: [The wheel of fashion]
cards.caption: A great wheel of hats spinning through the years.

cards.title: [Letters as monuments]
cards.caption: Giant letters standing like a gateway, a tiny figure balancing on top.
